description: Settings for the Zalo Mini App employee portal

fields.label: Company Display Name
fields.description: Shown on the Mini App intro screen

fields.label: Payslip
fields.description: Unticked = hidden in the Mini App and refused by the server. The Home screen always shows the employee card (name, employee ID, section, group, date of joining).

fields.label: Payslip
fields.description: Payslip list and detail screens, and the latest payslip card on Home

fields.label: Pay Day of Month
fields.description: Day of the month after the period ends on which salary is paid. Shown as the expected pay date of unpublished payslips

fields.label: Show Zero Lines by Default
fields.description: When unticked, payslip lines with a zero amount are hidden in the Mini App. Totals are always shown. The employee can still toggle it in the app

fields.label: Check Formulas on Import
fields.description: Ticked: Payslip Upload warns when totals do not add up (3 = 1 + 2, 9 = 5 - 6 + 7 + 8, group = sum of its lines) and HR must confirm. Unticked: the numbers in HR's file are imported as they are

Text of each line on the Mini App payslip, shown word for word (line number and letters included, e.g. 9 Thực lĩnh (j=f-g+h+i)). Rows follow the TIQN Payslip fields (added / removed by IT); edit only the Mini App Label. Employees who already opened a payslip see a new text once the app cache expires
fields.label: Payslip Lines on the Mini App
Attendance
fields.description: Attendance calendar, day detail and period summary, and the today / attendance cards on Home

fields.label: Overtime
fields.description: Overtime hours inside the attendance screens and on Home. Needs Attendance

fields.label: Create Attendance Explanation
fields.description: Button to send an attendance explanation from the day detail. Needs Attendance

fields.label: View Leave
fields.description: Leave balance and leave application list, and the annual leave card on Home

fields.label: Create Leave Application
fields.description: Button to create a leave application. Needs View Leave

fields.label: Attachments
fields.description: Files employees attach to a leave application or an attendance explanation

fields.label: Notifications
fields.description: Notification list and the unread badge (e.g. "Payslip 10/2026 has been published")

fields.label: Invite to Follow OA
fields.description: Card on Home inviting the employee to follow the company Zalo Official Account

fields.label: Read-only Days After Leaving
fields.description: A former employee can still view their data for this many days, counted from the Relieving Date. A new Zalo account of someone past this window is disabled automatically.

fields.label: Minimum Mini App Version
fields.description: Older Mini App builds receive CLIENT_TOO_OLD and must be updated

fields.label: Zalo App Review
fields.description: Zalo's app reviewers sign in with their own Zalo account and see SAMPLE data only - never a real employee's data. Phones of real employees always sign in as the employee.

fields.label: Reviewer Phones
fields.description: One phone per line, as given by Zalo (e.g. 0831111111). Turning Review Mode off or removing a phone ends that reviewer's session at once.

fields.label: Chat with C&B
fields.description: The "Chat with C&B" button in the Mini App opens a 1-1 Zalo chat with this person

fields.label: C&B Chat ID (ID by OA)
fields.description: Zalo "ID by OA" of the payroll staff member - copy it from their TIQN Portal Account (filled after they open the Mini App). NOT the Zalo User ID: that one does not open a chat

fields.label: C&B Chat Name
fields.description: Shown on the button, e.g. "Ms. Lan - Payroll"

fields.label: OA ID
fields.description: Used by followOA() and openChat() in the Mini App

fields.label: Fallback: Chat with OA
fields.description: Used only when no C&B chat ID is set below: the chat button opens the Official Account instead

fields.label: Send OA Messages
fields.description: Not used yet. Keep unticked until the recipient list has been reviewed

fields.label: Legal
fields.description: Published without login at /portal-policy and /portal-terms

name: Employee Portal Settings
